description: Same input, same output, no side effects: no I/O, clock, randomness, globals or mutation of arguments.
Business decisions live in pure functions; a thin outer layer (handler, job) does the I/O and passes values in.
Return new objects and arrays instead of changing existing ones, like React state updates. `readonly` and `Object.freeze` help enforce it.
Building behavior from small functions. `pipe(f, g)(x)` is `g(f(x))`: left to right, in reading order.
A function that takes or returns functions, such as `percentOff(10)` returning a pricing rule.
Store money as integers in the smallest unit to avoid floating point errors; round once, explicitly.
